decisions.reason: Core advanced packaging product aligned with established wafer business, so likely retained.
Carrier wafers are part of the established offer and support the strategic focus on reusable carriers, so keep.
Copper interposer wafers address growing advanced packaging demand and build on core capabilities, so keep.
Off-the-shelf wafer brand leverages existing standard products and expands customer access, so keep.
Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core semiconductor wafer business and likely lack sufficient traction, so drop to refocus resources.
